questions.question: Name the Indian music composer of songs for the film 'Slumdog Millionare'.
questions.solution:
The music for the acclaimed film 'Slumdog Millionaire' was composed by AR Rahman.
  • Global Success: His work on this film earned him two Academy Awards (Oscars) for Best Original Score and Best Original Song ('Jai Ho').
  • Style: The soundtrack is noted for blending traditional Indian sounds with contemporary electronic beats.
Note: AR Rahman is often referred to as the 'Isai Puyal' (Musical Storm) in his native Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Anil Srinivasan is one of the unique artists of India who plays which musical instrument?
questions.solution:
Anil Srinivasan is a renowned musician known for his unique contribution to Western Classical Piano within the context of Indian music.
  • Innovation: He is credited with creating a new aesthetic by pairing the piano with Carnatic vocals and instruments like the violin and mandolin.
  • Educator: He also founded the 'Rhapsody' initiative to integrate music into school curriculums.

questions.question: Balakrishnabuwa Ichalkaranjikar was associated with which of the following musical gharanas?
questions.solution:
Balakrishnabuwa Ichalkaranjikar was a pioneer of the Gwalior Gharana in Maharashtra.
  • Legacy: He is credited with bringing the Khayal style of singing from Gwalior to Western India.
  • Influence: He was the teacher of Vishnu Digambar Paluskar, who further popularized Hindustani classical music across the country.

questions.question: Which of the following musical instruments was played by Ustad Asad Ali Khan?
questions.solution:
Ustad Asad Ali Khan was one of the last great masters of the Rudra Veena.
  • Genre: He performed in the Dhrupad style, specifically the Khandarbani school.
  • Significance: The Rudra Veena is a large plucked string instrument used in Hindustani classical music, known for its deep, resonant bass tones.

questions.question: Whose name was recorded in the Guinness Book of World Records for recording 28 songs in one day in 1993?
questions.solution:
Playback singer Kumar Sanu holds the Guinness World Record for recording 28 songs in a single day in 1993.
  • Era: He dominated the Bollywood music scene in the 1990s, winning the Filmfare Best Male Playback Singer Award for five consecutive years.
  • Notable Works: He is famous for hits in movies like Aashiqui and Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge.

questions.question: Who among the following composer gained global recognition for his song 'Naatu Naatu' from action film RRR?
questions.solution:
The composer MM Keeravani (also known as M.M. Kreem) gained immense global recognition for the song 'Naatu Naatu' from the film RRR.
  • Historical Win: The song became the first from an Indian film to win an Oscar for Best Original Song in 2023.
  • Awards: It also secured a Golden Globe and a Critics' Choice Movie Award.

questions.question: Which of the following songs was NOT sung by Kishore Kumar?
questions.option_1: Yaari Hai Imam Mera Yaar Meri Zindagi
questions.option_2: Kora Kagaz Tha Yeh Man Mera
questions.solution:
The song 'Yaari Hai Imaan Mera Yaar Meri Zindagi' was not sung by Kishore Kumar; it was sung by Manna Dey for the film Zanjeer.
  • Other Options: 'Kora Kagaz Tha Yeh Man Mera', 'Gaata Rahe Mera Dil', and 'Dekha Ek Khwaab' are all iconic hits by Kishore Kumar.
  • Context: Manna Dey was another legendary playback singer known for his classical training and versatility.

questions.question: Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia is the rapper who debuted with the song 'DJ wale babu'. What is his professional name?
questions.solution:
Badshah is the professional stage name of Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia.
  • Career: He is a prominent Indian rapper and singer known for his work in Hindi, Punjabi, and Haryanvi music.
  • Debut: His breakout independent single 'DJ Waley Babu' became a massive club hit and trendsetter in the Indian rap scene.

questions.question: Who is the female singer of the song 'London Thumagda' from the film Queen?
questions.solution:
The high-energy song 'London Thumakda' from the movie Queen features the female vocals of Neha Kakkar.
  • Singing Style: Neha Kakkar is known for her distinctive peppy voice and has become one of the most followed Indian artists on social media.
  • Collaboration: The song was composed by Amit Trivedi and also features singers Labh Janjua and Sonu Kakkar.

questions.question: Name the singer who rose to prominence after recording the song 'Ishq wala love', which was released in the year 2012.
questions.solution:
Neeti Mohan rose to fame with the hit song 'Ishq Wala Love' from the 2012 film Student of the Year.
  • Breakthrough: For this song, she won the Filmfare RD Burman Award for New Music Talent.
  • Background: She was also a member of the pop band Aasma before entering Bollywood playback singing.

questions.question: The film RRR was bestowed with the esteemed Golden Globe award in the category of 'Best Original Song' for the composition 'Natu Natu'. Who are the singers of this song?
questions.solution:
The singers of the Golden Globe-winning song 'Naatu Naatu' are Rahul Sipligunj and Kaala Bhairava.
  • Performance: They famously performed the song live at the 95th Academy Awards ceremony.
  • Composition: The high-tempo track was composed by MM Keeravani with lyrics by Chandrabose.

questions.question: Dalchand Sharma is an eminent Pakhawaj exponent of which of the following gharanas?
questions.solution:
Dalchand Sharma is a master of the Pakhawaj, representing the Nathdwara Gharana.
  • Instrument: The Pakhawaj is a barrel-shaped, two-headed drum, primarily used as an accompaniment for Dhrupad singing and Odissi dance.
  • Style: The Nathdwara style is closely associated with the Haveli Sangeet tradition of Rajasthan.

questions.question: Which of the following Gharanas of Kathak was Pandit Ishwari Prasad related to?
questions.solution:
Pandit Ishwari Prasad is considered the foundational figure of the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak dance.
  • History: Legend has it that Lord Krishna appeared in his dream and instructed him to develop Kathak as a form of worship.
  • Lineage: He was the ancestor of legendary maestros like Shambhu Maharaj and Birju Maharaj.

questions.question: Shruti Sadolikar is an Indian classical singer of the Khayal genre of which Gharana?
questions.solution:
Shruti Sadolikar is a distinguished vocalist of the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana.
  • Genre: She is a master of the Khayal style and is also known for her performances of semi-classical forms like Thumri and Natya Sangeet.
  • Legacy: She is the daughter and disciple of Pandit Wamanrao Sadolikar.

questions.question: She was a Carnatic legendary singer who sang in Europe, North America and at the United Nations General Assembly. Who was she?
questions.solution:
M. S. Subbulakshmi (Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi) was a legendary Carnatic vocalist.
  • Global Icon: She was the first musician ever to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor.
  • UN Performance: She famously performed at the UN General Assembly in 1966.
  • Award: She was also the first Indian musician to receive the Ramon Magsaysay Award.

questions.question: ‘Streets Of Calcutta’ and ‘Dancing Drums’ are the two popular tracks of ______________.
questions.solution:
Ananda Shankar was a pioneer in Indo-Western fusion music, known for tracks like 'Streets of Calcutta' and 'Dancing Drums'.
  • Innovation: He blended Indian classical music (sitar) with Western rock and electronic sounds using Moog synthesizers.
  • Family: He was the son of the legendary dancer Uday Shankar and the nephew of sitar maestro Ravi Shankar.

questions.question: Bismillah Khan, the shehnai maestro, was born in the town of Dumraon which is now located in the Indian state of _______.
questions.solution:
The Shehnai maestro Ustad Bismillah Khan was born in Dumraon, Bihar.
  • Legacy: He is credited with bringing the Shehnai from the wedding mandap to the classical concert stage.
  • Honor: He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2001.

questions.question: Raga 'Laswanti' was composed by whom among the following personalities?
questions.solution:
Ustad Ali Akbar Khan, a legendary Sarod player of the Maihar Gharana, composed the Raga Laswanti.
  • Contribution: He was instrumental in popularizing Indian classical music in the West and founded the Ali Akbar College of Music in California.
  • Style: His playing was known for its technical brilliance and emotional depth.

questions.question: Which title was given to Begum Akhtar?
questions.solution:
Begum Akhtar (Akhtari Bai Faizabadi) was bestowed with the title 'Mallika-e-Ghazal' or the Queen of Ghazals.
  • Art Forms: She was an unparalleled exponent of Ghazal, Thumri, and Dadra styles of Hindustani classical music.
  • Recognition: She was posthumously awarded the Padma Bhushan.

questions.question: Who among the following was a Shehnai player and performed at Delhi’s Red Fort as the Indian flag unfurled at the hour of India’s independence on 15 August 1947?
questions.solution:
Ustad Bismillah Khan was chosen by Jawaharlal Nehru to play the Shehnai at the Red Fort on 15 August 1947 to herald India's Independence.
  • Significance: His performance became an integral part of the Independence Day ritual, and he performed there every year until his death.

questions.question: Who among the following singers is the recipient of all the three awards Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan?
questions.solution:
The legendary playback singer S.P. Balasubrahmanyam (SPB) is a recipient of the Padma Shri (2001), Padma Bhushan (2011), and Padma Vibhushan (posthumously in 2021).
  • Records: He holds the record for recording the highest number of songs (over 40,000) in various Indian languages.
  • Versatility: Besides singing, he was a prolific actor, producer, and voice-over artist.

questions.question: In 2016, Pandit Birju Maharaj won the Filmfare Award for Best Choreography for which film?
questions.solution:
Pandit Birju Maharaj won the Filmfare Award for Best Choreography for the song 'Mohe Rang Do Laal' from the film 'Bajirao Mastani'.
  • Kathak Master: He was a leading exponent of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana.
  • Cinema: He also won a National Film Award for choreography in the movie Vishwaroopam.

questions.question: The Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan award for 2020 was given to which of the following personalities?
questions.option_2: Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan
questions.solution:
The Sangeetha Kala Vibhushan award for 2020 was conferred upon the famous dancing duo Shanta and V.P. Dhananjayan.
  • Legacy: Known as the 'Dhananjayans', they are icons of Bharatanatyam and founders of the Bharata Kalanjali school.
  • Style: They are celebrated for their technical perfection and for popularizing male participation in Bharatanatyam.

questions.question: Which dance and singing form of Manipur was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2013?
questions.solution:
Sankirtana, a form of ritual singing, drumming, and dancing from Manipur, was inscribed on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2013.
  • Function: It is performed to mark various stages in the life of the Vaishnava people of Manipur plains.
  • Performance: It typically involves two drummers and about ten singer-dancers performing in a hall or domestic courtyard.
